 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Devnarayan Mishra

On The 8 th Of October, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 38909 of 2025
 Shiv Kumar Rajak
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Rakesh Dwivedi - Advocate for applicant.
 Ms. Shikha Baghel - Panel Lawyer for State.
 Order

Learned counsel for applicant has submitted that due to inadvertently, the applicant in his petition has marked the Crime Number as 140/2025 and in the bail order of this Court, the Crime Number has been also mentioned as 140/2025 whereas the actual Crime Number is 140/2024, hence, the applicant be permitted to correct the Crime Number in his petition as 140/2024 in place of Crime No.140/2025 and in the order of this Court passed in M.Cr.C. No.36587/2025 be also mentioned that order belongs to Crime No.140/2024 registered at Police Station - Amiliya, District -Sidhi for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 323 and 506 of the IPC.
2. Looking to the aforesaid factual aspects, the petition is allowed.

3. Learned counsel for applicant is directed to amend the cause title of bail application i.e. M.Cr.C.
No.36587/2025 and it is clarified that Crime Number mentioned in the M.Cr.C. No.36587/2025 be read as Crime NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50941 2 MCRC-38909-2025 No.140/2024, Police Station - Amiliya, District - Sidhi for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 323 and 506 of the IPC.
4.
In view of the aforesaid, this M.Cr.C. is disposed of.
A copy of this order be kept in the original bail application i.e. M.Cr.C. No.36587/2025.

(DEVNARAYAN MISHRA) JUDGE DPS Shiv Kumar Rajak vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188821748/
